Good catch, and that's the third check paying off already. 341 vs her ~340 estimate is a nice confirmation.

Worth adding to your pilot-2 checklist on Tuesday: before the session, ask Daniel roughly how many chats he has in each tool, so you have an expected number to compare against during the import rather than relying on him noticing.
One more small thing for the summary screen: show the fetched count next to the imported count (`341 found · 341 imported`). If those two ever diverge, the user sees it before you do.
